common_boundary.role_in_c16: Each family is only a fractional, equal-notional settlement-mark sleeve in a gross diagnostic. It is not a selected position, contract quantity, allocation or order.
common_boundary.current_rule_date_boundary: The rule pages are dated 2026 and document exchange-level base terms. They cannot be projected backward as session-specific historical margin, limit, fee, calendar, delivery or broker conditions.
common_boundary.execution_boundary: A daily settlement field is not a bid/ask quote or fill. Personal access, short permission, broker margin add-ons, commission, forced-close timing, delivery controls and taxes remain unverified.
